visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair wearing a black long-sleeved dress stands in an outdoor sunny parking lot. She looks directly at the camera with an expressive face, pointing her finger forward while speaking animatedly. Behind her are parked cars and a modern dealership building with glass windows and horizontal slats. (2) A man wearing a grey t-shirt, beige cargo pants, and a black baseball cap sits on some grey concrete steps. He is positioned in front of a large red Nissan brand sign. He gestures with his right hand as he talks toward the camera. Bright sunlight casts clear shadows on the ground around him. (3) Inside a brightly lit car dealership showroom with white tiled floors, the man and woman stand together, waving happily. They are positioned near several white SUVs. The camera then cuts to various close-ups of a white Nissan X-Trail, showing its headlights, wheels, and a black V-motion grille. (4) The woman is assisted into the front seat of the white SUV by the man. Inside, the camera focuses on her feet wearing white sneakers as colorful ambient floor lighting shifts between purple and blue. A retractable side step is shown moving automatically from beneath the car door frame. (5) The woman sits inside the vehicle looking delighted, followed by a series of fast-paced detail shots of the car's interior dashboard, black wheels, and rear spoiler. Finally, the couple appears together again, laughing and hugging while holding a smartphone, standing next to the vehicle as the video concludes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, cheerful acoustic guitar music begins with a steady rhythmic drum beat. A female voice speaks with high arousal and a bright, friendly tone, projecting her voice clearly. There is a slight urban background hum, but the speech remains the dominant signal above the music. (2) Hard cut to a male voice that is energetic and authoritative yet friendly. He speaks at a fast rate, synchronized with the upbeat tempo of the background music. Each transition is marked by a subtle whoosh sound effect, maintaining a highly dynamic and engaging acoustic texture throughout. (3) A series of metallic dings and cartoonish pop sound effects are layered over the voices as specific car features are highlighted. The man and woman engage in a lively dialogue with frequent pitch variations, conveying excitement. The music remains a consistent, upbeat major-key background bed. (4) A soft mechanical whirring sound is heard briefly, mimicking the side-step movement. The audio remains studio-clean with high fidelity. The video ends with a warm vocal exchange between the couple and a final bright musical chord, with a notification chime emphasizing the call to action on the screen.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Presentation of Choice -> Feature Showcase -> Incentive/Reward -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog showcasing the limited edition Nissan X-Trail 'Loka' series. By presenting a couple's visit to the dealership, it highlights exclusive features like black wheels and motorized steps while advertising a test-drive reward featuring CAMA Cafe vouchers.
